decisions.reason: Current exact School of Business Analytics and Marketing independently verified, with substantive Operations/SCM research. Imported Business Analytics is field label, not invented separate department or dated rename.

sources.note: Entire Business School postgraduate research page read. Exact Doctor of Philosophy (Business), original independent research/dissertation, proposal defence within 12 months and annual review. PhD research areas explicitly across diverse Business Schools; MPhil separate. Incidental placement/client testimonials not used as graduate histories.

Entire current School of Business Analytics and Marketing page read. Actual new school within University of Sydney Business School; research expertise scheduling problems, supply chains, optimisation/econometrics and organisational productivity/efficiency. This is substantive Operations/SCM application scope, not pure generic analytics. No separate current department named Business Analytics inferred.

Entire current School of International Business Logistics and Supply Chains page read. Actual school within Business School, disciplines International Business and Logistics and Supply Chain Management, Institute of Transport and Logistics Studies. Substantive research transport modes/systems/logistics/supply chains/infrastructure/sustainability; undergraduate/postgraduate/research study routes explicitly linked. Same broad Business PhD, not new school-specific PhD award.

Entire current Faculty Engineering postgraduate research page read. Exact Doctor of Philosophy (Engineering), original contribution and thesis research, seven schools including Aerospace, Mechanical and Mechatronic, Biomedical, Chemical and Biomolecular, Civil, CS, Electrical and Information, Project Management. Broad engineering award not automatically Industrial Engineering or OR PhD.

Entire current School Project Management page read. Actual PhD research environment; emphasis human/social project organising, climate/resilience/equity/innovation. Generic project management/sector applications not by themselves substantive IE/Ops scope, no qualifying Engineering PhD route recorded from this alone. Other engineering schools detailed fields unexamined.

limitations: Current Business Analytics and Marketing school replaces subject-only imported label for display; no historical restructuring date inferred.
Doctor of Philosophy (Business) is one broad Business School award with multiple research fields; no separate duplicate degree per school/discipline.
Engineering PhD actual award verified as discovery route, but relevant detailed fields across other engineering schools remain incomplete; generic project leadership not sufficient Operations scope.
